svg.title: Pidgty realtime call sequence
svg.desc: Excalidraw sequence diagram separating authenticated WebSocket coordination, Redis relationship and session lookup, peer notification, and the Cloudflare Realtime WebRTC media path.

g.text: A Pidgty Call, Split by Responsibility
the backend coordinates the relationship and session; Cloudflare carries the realtime media
WebRTC handshake with the shared session
Hangup returns through the backend so the peer is notified
and call duration can be recorded.
